blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Taxes can sound hard, but in English they follow simple patterns. Today we learn five useful words about income tax. Go slowly — one step at a time.

First, the company has income and every worker has a salary. Every year we send a tax return. On the form we check the deductions, because a deduction makes the tax smaller. Sometimes the worker gets money back — that is a refund.

The words are short and clear. The company has forms, and each form has numbers. When you know the words, taxes are easier. You can do it!

items.q: How many tax words does the text teach today?
items.why: "Today we learn five useful words about income tax."

items.q: What does a deduction do to the tax?
items.why: "a deduction makes the tax smaller."

items.q: What is a refund?
items.why: "Sometimes the worker gets money back — that is a refund."

items.q: The text suggests that taxes are easier when you…
items.why: Inferência: "When you know the words, taxes are easier." O texto liga saber as palavras a facilidade.

items.q: The tone of the text suggests the author wants you to feel…
items.why: Inferência: "Go slowly — one step at a time. You can do it!" — o tom é de encorajamento e calma.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie ajudando um colega a entender o imposto de renda. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Sit down, this is easy. Look, you have your salary here, every month. And the company has your income on this form. Same idea, two words. Don't worry.

Now, this line is the tax return. We send it once a year. It is a simple form. You just put the correct numbers here and here.

See this? These are the deductions. A deduction is good for you, because it makes the tax smaller. So we check every deduction, slowly, one by one. We never rush.

And at the end, look — the refund. That is money back for you. Nice, right? When there is a refund, it comes to your account.

So: salary, income, tax return, deduction, refund. Five small words. Say them with me. You have all the words now. Good job! Next month it will be even easier.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does the company have on the form, according to Sophie?
items.why: "the company has your income on this form."

items.q: How often do they send the tax return?
items.why: "this line is the tax return. We send it once a year."

items.q: Why does Sophie say the deduction is good for you?
options: It gives you a new salary
items.why: "A deduction is good for you, because it makes the tax smaller."

items.q: Why does Sophie check every deduction slowly, one by one?
options: Because she wants them to be correct and calm
Because there are too many forms
items.why: Inferência: "we check every deduction, slowly, one by one. We never rush." — a ideia é cuidado e calma.

items.q: How does Sophie feel about the colleague learning taxes?
items.why: Inferência: "Don't worry… Good job! Next month it will be even easier." — tom paciente e encorajador.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "My salary comes on the fifth of every month." A salary is…
options: the money you get for your work
items.why: Salary = salário, o dinheiro pago pelo seu trabalho.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We send the ___ to the government once a year."
items.why: Tax return = declaração de imposto, o formulário enviado ao governo.

items.q: "Each deduction makes the final tax smaller." A deduction is…
options: an amount taken off the tax
items.why: Deduction = dedução, um valor descontado do imposto.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The company has a lot of ___ this year, so it pays more tax."
items.why: Income = renda, o dinheiro que a empresa recebe.

items.q: "I paid too much, so I get a refund." A refund is…
options: money that comes back to you
items.why: Refund = restituição, o dinheiro que volta para você.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho com impostos. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the tax return." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "Let's fill in the form together." To fill in a form means to…
options: put the numbers in the blank spaces
items.why: Fill in = preencher, colocar as informações nos espaços.

items.q: "Please check over the numbers before we send." To check over means to…
items.why: Check over = revisar, olhar com cuidado.

items.q: "We are almost at the deadline." A deadline is…
options: the last day to do something
items.why: Deadline = prazo final, o último dia para fazer algo.

items.q: "Don't worry, I will help you out with the tax return." To help someone out means to…
items.why: Help out = ajudar alguém com uma tarefa.
